concepts.name: Banking And Finance 89 Introduction One
concepts.simple_definition: Unit 5: Banking and Finance 89 Introduction One of the basic factors of production in economics is capital
concepts.deep_explanation: Capital is the amount of money the producer pays for the other factors of production (labor, land and entrepreneur) used in the production process
concepts.real_example: Practical example of Banking and Finance 89 Introduction One  from page 97.
concepts.common_confusion: Students sometimes confuse Banking and Finance 89 Introduction One  with adjacent topics in Chapter 5.

concepts.name: Banking And Finance 91 Economy Or Countr
concepts.simple_definition: Unit 5: Banking and Finance 91 economy or country cannot function well without money (finance), just as the body cannot function without blood circulating in it
concepts.deep_explanation: We use it to buy our day-to-day needs (demand = willingness + Ability; where ability is the money or finance, we have)
